description: AlphaProVaultFactory.createVault() never validates params.pool, so an attacker can register a fake Uniswap V3 pool. uniswapV3MintCallback only checks msg.sender == address(pool) and then safeTransfers whatever amounts the pool requests. Attack: deploy EvilPool, call createVault(pool=EvilPool), victims deposit into the officially registered vault, then the manager calls rebalance() and the fake pool's callback drains the vault. Vault went from 1000 TK0 + 1000 TK1 to 0 + 0; the fake pool received 1000 TK0 + 1000 TK1 via real ERC20 transfers.
poc_notes: PoC passed on new code (commit 0174095) and old mainnet code (commit 0b84ade3) on a local chain: vault 1000 TK0 + 1000 TK1 drained to 0 + 0, fake pool received 1000 + 1000. Mainnet factory 0x8C554F200B1EEECdE99370Fe6284B15d23E50E07 is non-upgradeable and unpatched; its code contains no pool check.
title: Fake Uniswap V3 pool drains Alpha Vault via unchecked createVault pool and mint callback
